user.title: Connect to Monero Wallet RPC
user.description: Enter the connection details for your monero-wallet-rpc instance. Multiple endpoints can be entered (one per line) for automatic failover.

data_description.endpoints: One endpoint per line, e.g. `192.168.1.100:18084`. HTTP/HTTPS prefix and `/json_rpc` path are added automatically if missing. Multiple endpoints are tried in order as fallback.
data_description.username: HTTP Digest auth username, if wallet-rpc is started with `--rpc-login user:pass`.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Monero Wallet RPC
reconfigure.description: Update connection settings. Leave the password field blank to keep the current value.

data_description.endpoints: One endpoint per line. Multiple endpoints are tried in order as fallback.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the wallet RPC. Check the endpoint address and network connectivity.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check username and password.
error.no_endpoints: At least one endpoint is required.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This wallet RPC is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the wallet for updated balances and transfers. Minimum 60 s. Default is 3600 s (1 h).

cannot_connect.title: Cannot reach Monero wallet RPC for {wallet_name}
cannot_connect.description:
Home Assistant failed to connect to the Monero wallet RPC for **{wallet_name}**.

Check that `monero-wallet-rpc` is running and all configured endpoints are reachable, then go to **Settings → Devices & services → {wallet_name}** and select **Reconfigure** or **Reload**.
